title: Loop of the Recursive Dragon — Computing Concepts, Chapters 4-6: Control Flow, Collections & Objects
intro_html:
A free quiz-RPG for an introductory computing course, chapters 4-6: Control Flow, Collections & Objects. Battle monsters by answering questions about control flow and functions, collections and abstract data types, and modules and object-oriented programming.

Pick a set below to begin. Your progress is recorded in this course's gradebook.
